title: Quran Ayat
body:
98 Seek refuge with Allah from the evil of shaitan. FirstRabiUlAwwal KeepingPeaceIsBest
116 They will never prosper AhluHawa
127 And do thou be patient, for thy patience is but from God, nor grieve over them, and distress not thyself because of their
plots. ReturnAndSeekTheLight

128 For God is with those who restrain themselves, and those who do good. ReturnAndSeekTheLight

Sura 17 Al-Isra

5 When the first of the warnings came to pass, We sent against you Our servants given to terrible warfare. They entered the
very inmost parts of your homes and it was a warning (completely) fulfilled. WorldIsACarcass

8 But if you revert (to sinning), We shall revert (to chastising you). WorldIsACarcass
44 And there is not a thing but celebrates His praise! BeRabbaniyin RoyalGarmentsNoHonor

TeachingOfTheDove

70 Verily, We have honored the Children of Adam. AdabYaHu AlBayan BeRabbaniyin BeStraight

ChildrenOfAdamCertainlyHonoured MuqtadirJallaJalalahu RespectAllHumanBeings
SeekProvision WeDoNotOppress YouPlayWithTechnology

79 (O Muhammad!) It maybe that your Lord will raise you to the Praised Station. DivineServiceIsHigher

MaqamAlMahmud

80 And say, “O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honor, and likewise my exit by the Gate of Truth and
Honor, and grant me from Your Presence an authority to aid (me).” NecessityOfSaintlyGuide

81 And say,"Truth has (now) arrived and falsehood perished, for falsehood is (by its nature) bound to perish."

DontBlameAllah StickForDisobedient

85 Say (O Muhammad), "The soul is from the affair of your Lord, but what you have been given of knowledge is very little (O
men)." YouPlayWithTechnology

Sura 18 Al-Kahf

10 Behold, the youths betook themselves to the Cave. They said, "Our Lord! bestow on us mercy from You, and dispose of our
affair for us in the right way!" NecessityOfSaintlyGuide

17 He whom Allah guides is rightly guided, but he whom Allah leaves to stray, for him you will not find a protector to lead him
to the Right Way. NecessityOfSaintlyGuide

29 Then whosoever wills let him believe, and whosoever wills let him disbelieve. FearOfAllah

IfAllahKnowsWhatWellDo

64 That is what we were seeking! RighteousRulerOfEgypt
65 So they found one of Our servants, on whom We had bestowed mercy from Ourselves and whom We had taught knowledge
from Our Presence. MuqtadirJallaJalalahu PerfectionOfPride

84 Min Kulli Shay'in Sababaan. HighHimmat
85 and so he chose the right means. SeekTheMeansOfApproach
107 Those who believe & do good deeds, shall have the Heaven of Firdaus for their pleasure. BeStraight

WhereIsYourSultan WordOfHaqq

108 Wherein they shall dwell. No desire will they have to be removed therefrom. BeStraight WhereIsYourSultan

WordOfHaqq

109 Say (O Muhammad), "And if the oceans were ink and the trees pens, they would be used up before writing the Words of
our Lord." ImportantMessage

Sura 19 Maryam

94 He does take an account of them (all) and has numbered them (all) exactly. AfterKingsComeTyrants

Sura 20 Ta-Ha
